description: This PHP file defines an API endpoint class for validating leave entitlements within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It includes methods for handling HTTP GET requests to verify if a specific leave entitlement is valid based on provided parameters, and utilizes various traits and external classes for business logic and validation.

classes.name: ValidationLeaveEntitlementValueAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for validating leave entitlement data, handling GET requests to verify entitlement validity based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to validate a leave entitlement, returning whether the entitlement is valid and days used.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request parameters, ensuring ID is positive and entitlement is zero or positive.
